home.title: Make photos lighter.
home.lede: Smaller photos for messages, email and forms. Done on this phone, nothing is uploaded.
intro.1.title: Pick photos
intro.1.body: Choose one or many from your library.
intro.2.title: Say what they're for
intro.2.body: A message, an email, a form. Compresso picks the right size.
intro.3.title: Nothing leaves your phone
intro.3.body: Your originals stay exactly as they are. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
purpose.title: What are they for?
purpose.message.name: Message
purpose.message.hint: About 400 KB each. Good for chats and texts.
purpose.email.name: Email
purpose.upload.name: Upload form
purpose.upload.hint: Under a size limit you choose.
purpose.space.name: Save space
purpose.space.hint: Same look on screen, much smaller. Keeps date and place.
purpose.web.name: Website
purpose.web.hint: Fast-loading photos for a site or online shop.
job.kept: Already as small as it gets. Kept as it was.
job.missed: Smallest possible, still above the limit.
job.failed: This photo could not be read.
fine.title: Fine-tune
fine.qualityHint: Lower is smaller, with softer detail.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Compresso works entirely on this phone. It has no account, no ads and no tracking, and it never uploads your photos.
settings.openSource: Built on the open-source compresso.js library.
error.permission: Compresso needs permission to add photos to your library. You can allow it in Settings.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
purpose.clearAll: Remove all photos from the list
purpose.cleared: List cleared. Your originals are untouched.
job.ready: Ready, but not saved yet. Tap Save to keep them.
job.readyOne: Ready, but not saved yet. Tap Save to keep it.
job.noneDone: Nothing to save this time. Tap Retry, or Back to choose again.
job.whereAndroid: Saved. Find them in your Gallery, in the album called Compresso.
job.whereIos: Saved. Find them in Photos, next to the originals, under the same date.
job.pick: Tap a photo to see it
purpose.tapPhoto: Tap a photo to adjust or remove it.
photo.sharedHint: This photo uses the settings chosen for all photos.
photo.ownHint: Only this photo uses these. The others keep the shared settings.
